interface.longDescription: Practise English with existing grammar and vocabulary exercises inside ChatGPT. Find a topic and CEFR level, then complete gap-fill questions, sentence transformations or click-to-edit corrections. Get instant marking, hints, explanations and a final score with mistake review. Results stay in the current player; account progress is not saved. Dictation and audio practice are available on the website rather than through this plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me practise English with interactive exercises.

positive.description: Topic and CEFR filtering. Start a fresh conversation with the plugin selected.
positive.prompt: Find B1 exercises about the present perfect.
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_exercises with query present perfect and level B1. Return at most five matching exercises with their actual titles, levels, question counts and links. Use only returned catalogue entries.

positive.description: Gap-fill workflow and an external website link. Start a fresh conversation; complete all 20 questions, using Have and visited for the first question, and one deliberately incorrect answer to check mistake review.
positive.prompt: Open Present Perfect for Experience so I can practise.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the existing exercise, then call open_exercise with present-perfect-experience. Show the existing interactive player; it checks answers, supplies hints and explanations and reaches its score screen. The review shows accepted answers, not verb prompts. Get more free exercises requests host navigation to www.english-exercises.org.

positive.description: Sentence transformations. Start a fresh conversation and complete all questions in the returned exercise.
positive.prompt: Help me practise reported speech in the present simple with sentence transformations.
positive.expected_behavior: Find and open reported-speech-present-simple. The transformation player accepts the recorded answer variants, including contractions and terminal punctuation, and reaches the original score screen.

positive.description: Click-to-edit corrections. Start a fresh conversation and complete all questions by editing incorrect segments.
positive.prompt: Give me an exercise where I click and correct word-order mistakes.
positive.expected_behavior: Find and open word-order-error-correction. Show clickable segments, let the learner edit mistakes, mark the answers using the existing exercise data and reach the final score and review.

positive.description: Supported search with no results and recovery. Start a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: Find English exercises about zzzxxyy. If there are none, tell me.
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_exercises with query zzzxxyy. The exercises array is empty. Say there are no matching exercises and offer a different topic; do not fabricate titles or call open_exercise with an invented slug.

negative.description: Audio and dictation are outside this plugin. Explain the limit and point to the website without calling find_exercises or open_exercise for an unsupported dictation player.
negative.prompt: Play me an audio dictation exercise inside this plugin.

negative.description: The tools only return existing catalogue exercises. Explain that the plugin cannot generate a new custom player; do not invoke its tools to fabricate new questions or claim that a custom exercise was created.
negative.prompt: Create a completely new interactive exercise using these invented verbs: zorp and flim.

negative.description: No accounts or saved progress. Explain that scores stay in the current player; do not invoke find_exercises or open_exercise to save or retrieve account data, or claim progress was saved.
negative.prompt: Save my score to my English Exercises account and show my progress from last week.

review.commerce_description: Free English practice. No purchases, subscriptions or payment flows in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Corrected the public listing category and removed pricing language from the description. Exercise behaviour is unchanged from the recorded demo.
